    StartersFried egg canapésBrioche, quail egg and bacon, minus Ramada's bellyHow to make it1 small brioche loaf4 rashers of bacon12 quail eggs30g butter1 small bunch chivesCut 12 small rounds from the brioche and toast them.Fry the bacon until crisp and break into pieces.Fry the quail eggs in butter.Put an egg and a bit of bacon on each round and sprinkle with chives.Dead Meat's last chipsTwice-fried thick chips served with homemade garlic aioliHow to make it1kg potatoes1.5 L vegetable oil, for frying1 egg yolk1 garlic clove1 tbsp lemon juice200ml neutral oil, for the aiolisalt, to tasteCut the potatoes into thick chips.Fry in 140°C oil, then rest.Whisk the yolk, crushed garlic and lemon juice, then drip in the oil until thick.Fry again at 185°C until crisp.Salt the chips and serve with the aioli.Airbase soft pretzels with beer cheeseEnemy toast, not coast, sirHow to make itAs written, serves 4Warm soft pretzels brushed with butter and coarse salt, served with a hot, smooth cheddar and lager dip and a pot of grainy mustard.Brush 4 large soft pretzels with 30g melted butter, sprinkle with coarse salt and warm at 200°C for 5 minutes.Melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then whisk in 200ml lager and 100ml milk until thick.Off the heat, stir in 200g grated sharp cheddar, 1 tsp Dijon and a pinch of cayenne until smooth.Serve the pretzels with the cheese dip and wholegrain mustard.MainsAirbase rib eye, corn and slawRib eye, corn, slaw. The chafing dish is not yoursHow to make it4 rib eye steaks4 corn cobs1/4 cabbage2 carrots100g mayonnaise2 tbsp cider vinegar1 pinch caster sugarsalt, to tasteShred the cabbage and carrots and toss with the mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar and salt.Grill the steaks and corn over high heat.Rest the steaks and serve with corn and slaw.Ramada's sizzling chicken fajitasCooked on Ramada's belly in the film. We used a cast iron panHow to make it700g chicken thigh fillets2 tsp ground cumin1 tsp smoked paprika3 limes3 tbsp vegetable oil2 capsicums1 red onion8 flour tortillas2 avocados150g sour cream1 corianderSlice the chicken into strips and toss with the cumin, paprika, juice of 2 limes, 1 tbsp of the oil and salt.Mash the avocados with the last lime and salt.Get a cast iron pan smoking hot. Cook the chicken in the rest of the oil for 6 minutes, add the sliced capsicums and onion and cook for 4 minutes more.Take the pan to the table still sizzling, with warm tortillas, guacamole, sour cream and coriander.SweetsCustard tartsBaked egg custard tarts in sweet shortcrust, nutmeg on topHow to make it2 sheets of sweet shortcrust pastry3 eggs250ml milk125ml cream80g caster sugarnutmeg, to tasteHeat the oven to 180°C. Line a 12-hole muffin tray with rounds of pastry.Blind-bake the cases.Whisk the eggs, milk, cream and sugar.Fill the cases and grate nutmeg on top.Bake at 150°C until just set.Cool before serving.DrinksOfficers' club Moscow muleVodka, lime and spicy ginger beer in a chilled mugHow to make it4 copper or steel mugs1 tray ice180ml vodka60ml lime juice600ml spicy ginger beer, cold1 lime4 mint sprigsChill the mugs in the freezer, then fill with ice.Add vodka and lime juice to each mug.Top with ginger beer and stir once from the bottom.Garnish with a lime wheel and a slapped mint sprig.Vanilla malted milkWashout gets two.
